---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m5p3t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, Slots, Workers, NoJob, Quorum

VARIABLES alloc, votes, requested, active
vars == <<alloc, votes, requested, active>>

Voters(j, s) == { v.worker : v \in { x \in votes : x.job = j /\ x.slot = s } }

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Jobs \cup {NoJob}]
    /\ votes \subseteq [job : Jobs, slot : Slots, worker : Workers]
    /\ requested \subseteq [job : Jobs, slot : Slots]
    /\ active \subseteq Workers

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NoJob]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ requested = {}
    /\ active = Workers

Request(j, s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ \A r \in requested : r.slot # s
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \notin requested
    /\ requested' = requested \cup {[job |-> j, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, active>>

GoSlow(w) ==
    /\ w \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, requested>>

Resume(w) ==
    /\ w \notin active
    /\ active' = active \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, votes, requested>>

Vote(w, j, s) ==
    /\ w \in active
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \in requested
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s, worker |-> w] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[job |-> j, slot |-> s, worker |-> w]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, requested, active>>

Commit(j, s) ==
    /\ [job |-> j, slot |-> s] \in requested
    /\ alloc[s] = NoJob
    /\ Cardinality(Voters(j, s)) >= Quorum
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = j]
    /\ requested' = requested \ {[job |-> j, slot |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] # NoJob
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NoJob]
    /\ votes' = { x \in votes : x.slot # s }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requested, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Request(j, s)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : GoSlow(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Resume(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Vote(w, j, s)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Commit(j, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocBackedByQuorum ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        alloc[s] # NoJob => Cardinality(Voters(alloc[s], s)) >= Quorum
============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m9p1t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxSeats, MaxVer

VARIABLES log, version, prepared, pool
vars == <<log, version, prepared, pool>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq([inst : Instances, base : Nat])
    /\ version \in Nat
    /\ prepared \subseteq [inst : Instances, base : Nat]
    /\ pool \in 0..MaxSeats

Init ==
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ version = 0
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ pool = MaxSeats

Prepare(i) ==
    /\ \A p \in prepared : p.inst # i
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {[inst |-> i, base |-> version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

Refresh(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared :
        /\ p.inst = i
        /\ p.base # version
        /\ prepared' = (prepared \ {p}) \cup {[inst |-> i, base |-> version]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared :
        /\ p.inst = i
        /\ p.base = version
        /\ version < MaxVer
        /\ pool > 0
        /\ log' = Append(log, [inst |-> i, base |-> version])
        /\ version' = version + 1
        /\ pool' = pool - 1
        /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}

Discard(i) ==
    /\ \E p \in prepared : p.inst = i /\ prepared' = prepared \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, pool>>

ReleaseSeat ==
    /\ pool < MaxSeats
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, version, prepared>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Prepare(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Refresh(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Discard(i)
    \/ ReleaseSeat

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    /\ version = Len(log)
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(log) : log[k].base = k - 1
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {rA, rB}
    MaxSeats = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m8p5t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Instances, Symbols, NoOne

VARIABLES coarse, fine, open, plog
vars == <<coarse, fine, open, plog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Instances \cup {NoOne}
    /\ fine \in [Symbols -> Instances \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ open \subseteq Symbols
    /\ plog \in Seq([inst : Instances, sym : Symbols])

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NoOne
    /\ fine = [s \in Symbols |-> NoOne]
    /\ open = {}
    /\ plog = <<>>

AcquireCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = NoOne
    /\ coarse' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, open, plog>>

AcquireFine(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[s] = NoOne
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, open, plog>>

OpenBook(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ s \notin open
    /\ open' = open \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, plog>>

Print(i, s) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ fine[s] = i
    /\ s \in open
    /\ \A k \in DOMAIN plog : plog[k].sym # s
    /\ plog' = Append(plog, [inst |-> i, sym |-> s])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, open>>

ReleaseFine(i, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = i
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, open, plog>>

ReleaseCoarse(i) ==
    /\ coarse = i
    /\ \A s \in Symbols : fine[s] # i
    /\ coarse' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, open, plog>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AcquireCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : AcquireFine(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : OpenBook(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : Print(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Symbols : ReleaseFine(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : ReleaseCoarse(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoublePrint ==
    \A a, b \in DOMAIN plog : (a # b) => plog[a].sym # plog[b].sym
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {mA, mB}
    Symbols = {x, y}
    NoOne = NoOne
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoublePrint

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m5p4t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, Reqs, Reviewers, Quorum, Cap

VARIABLES pending, votes, active, done
vars == <<pending, votes, active, done>>

Voters(r) == { x.rev : x \in { y \in votes : y.req = r } }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pending \subseteq [id : Reqs, inst : Instances]
    /\ votes \subseteq [req : Reqs, rev : Reviewers]
    /\ active \subseteq Reqs
    /\ done \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ active = {}
    /\ done = {}

Submit(i, r) ==
    /\ r \notin active
    /\ r \notin done
    /\ \A p \in pending : p.id # r
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[id |-> r, inst |-> i]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, done>>

Vote(v, r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ [req |-> r, rev |-> v] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[req |-> r, rev |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active, done>>

Begin(r) ==
    /\ \E p \in pending : p.id = r
    /\ Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {r}
    /\ pending' = { p \in pending : p.id # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, done>>

Complete(r) ==
    /\ r \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {r}
    /\ done' = done \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, votes>>

Recall(r) ==
    /\ r \in done
    /\ done' = done \ {r}
    /\ votes' = { x \in votes : x.req # r }
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Reqs : Submit(i, r)
    \/ \E v \in Reviewers, r \in Reqs : Vote(v, r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Begin(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Complete(r)
    \/ \E r \in Reqs : Recall(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(active) <= Cap
    /\ \A r \in active : Cardinality(Voters(r)) >= Quorum
============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m1p4t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, Cap

Nodes == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(n) == (n + 1) % N

VARIABLES token, opened, want, adminOn
vars == <<token, opened, want, adminOn>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ opened \subseteq Nodes
    /\ want \subseteq Nodes
    /\ adminOn \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ opened = {}
    /\ want = {}
    /\ adminOn = FALSE

Request(n) ==
    /\ n \notin want
    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ want' = want \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, opened, adminOn>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<opened, want, adminOn>>

Open(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ n \in want
    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ Cardinality(opened) < Cap
    /\ opened' = opened \cup {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminOn>>

Close(n) ==
    /\ n \in opened
    /\ opened' = opened \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, want, adminOn>>

AdminToggle ==
    /\ adminOn' = ~adminOn
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, opened, want>>

AdminOpen(n) ==
    /\ adminOn
    /\ n \notin opened
    /\ Cardinality(opened) < Cap
    /\ opened' = opened \cup {n}
    /\ want' = want \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminOn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Request(n)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Open(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Close(n)
    \/ AdminToggle
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : AdminOpen(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BoundedOpen == Cardinality(opened) <= Cap
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedOpen

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m1p4t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS N, Trains, Zone, Cap

Blocks == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(b) == (b + 1) % N

VARIABLES pos, token, reqs, msgs
vars == <<pos, token, reqs, msgs>>

Occupied(b) == \E t \in Trains : pos[t] = b
InZone == { t \in Trains : pos[t] \in Zone }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pos \in [Trains -> Blocks]
    /\ token \in Blocks
    /\ reqs \subseteq Trains
    /\ msgs \subseteq [train : Trains, dest : Blocks]

Init ==
    /\ pos = [t \in Trains |-> 0]
    /\ token = 0
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ msgs = {}

Request(t) ==
    /\ t \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, token, msgs>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, reqs, msgs>>

Grant(t) ==
    /\ t \in reqs
    /\ token = pos[t]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[train |-> t, dest |-> Succ(pos[t])]}
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, token>>

Deliver(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ ~Occupied(m.dest)
    /\ (m.dest \in Zone => Cardinality(InZone) < Cap)
    /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![m.train] = m.dest]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Request(t)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Grant(t)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Deliver(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapOK == Cardinality(InZone) <= Cap
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 4
    Trains = {t1, t2}
    Zone = {1, 2}
    Cap = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapOK

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m8p3t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Fridges, Shelves, Handlers, Orders, NoOne, NoOrder

Slots == [fridge : Fridges, shelf : Shelves]

VARIABLES coarse, fine, alloc, slow
vars == <<coarse, fine, alloc, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Fridges -> Handlers \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ fine \in [Slots -> Handlers \cup {NoOne}]
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Orders \cup {NoOrder}]
    /\ slow \subseteq Handlers

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [f \in Fridges |-> NoOne]
    /\ fine = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NoOrder]
    /\ slow = {}

GoSlow(h) == /\ h \notin slow /\ slow' = slow \cup {h} /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, alloc>>
Resume(h) == /\ h \in slow /\ slow' = slow \ {h} /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, alloc>>

AcquireCoarse(h, f) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ coarse[f] = NoOne
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![f] = h]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, alloc, slow>>

AcquireFine(h, s) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ coarse[s.fridge] = h
    /\ fine[s] = NoOne
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = h]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, alloc, slow>>

Claim(h, s, o) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] = NoOrder
    /\ \A t \in Slots : alloc[t] # o
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slow>>

Deallocate(h, s) ==
    /\ h \notin slow
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] # NoOrder
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NoOrder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, slow>>

ReleaseFine(h, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = h
    /\ alloc[s] = NoOrder
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, alloc, slow>>

ReleaseCoarse(h, f) ==
    /\ coarse[f] = h
    /\ \A s \in Slots : (s.fridge = f) => fine[s] # h
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![f] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, alloc, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in Handlers : GoSlow(h)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers : Resume(h)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, f \in Fridges : AcquireCoarse(h, f)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : AcquireFine(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots, o \in Orders : Claim(h, s, o)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : Deallocate(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, s \in Slots : ReleaseFine(h, s)
    \/ \E h \in Handlers, f \in Fridges : ReleaseCoarse(h, f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllocProtected ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        alloc[s] # NoOrder =>
            /\ fine[s] # NoOne
            /\ coarse[s.fridge] = fine[s]
============================================================================

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m0p6t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Pharmacists, MaxCap

VARIABLES log, authorized, everAuth, readv, cap
vars == <<log, authorized, everAuth, readv, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq([who : Pharmacists, base : 0..MaxCap])
    /\ authorized \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ everAuth \subseteq Pharmacists
    /\ readv \in [Pharmacists -> 0..MaxCap]
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ authorized = {}
    /\ everAuth = {}
    /\ readv = [p \in Pharmacists |-> 0]
    /\ cap = 1

Grant(p) ==
    /\ p \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {p}
    /\ everAuth' = everAuth \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, readv, cap>>

Revoke(p) ==
    /\ p \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, everAuth, readv, cap>>

Read(p) ==
    /\ readv[p] # Len(log)
    /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![p] = Len(log)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, authorized, everAuth, cap>>

Commit(p) ==
    /\ p \in authorized
    /\ readv[p] = Len(log)
    /\ Len(log) < cap
    /\ log' = Append(log, [who |-> p, base |-> readv[p]])
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, everAuth, readv, cap>>

SetCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c # cap
    /\ c >= Len(log)
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, authorized, everAuth, readv>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Grant(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Revoke(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Commit(p)
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : SetCap(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleOrUnauth ==
    /\ Len(log) <= cap
    /\ \A k \in 1..Len(log) :
        /\ log[k].base = k - 1
        /\ log[k].who \in everAuth
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {ph1, ph2}
    MaxCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleOrUnauth

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m5p6t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Quorum, MaxSteps, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, votes, crashed, authorized, clog
vars == <<epoch, votes, crashed, authorized, clog>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ votes \subseteq [bank : Banks, epoch : 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Banks
    /\ authorized \subseteq Banks
    /\ clog \in Seq([voters : SUBSET Banks])

ValidVoters ==
    { v.bank : v \in { x \in votes :
        /\ x.epoch = epoch
        /\ x.bank \in authorized
        /\ x.bank \notin crashed } }

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ authorized = {}
    /\ clog = <<>>

Join(b) ==
    /\ b \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, votes, crashed, clog>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, votes, authorized, clog>>

Vote(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ [bank |-> b, epoch |-> epoch] \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[bank |-> b, epoch |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed, authorized, clog>>

Withdraw(b) ==
    /\ [bank |-> b, epoch |-> epoch] \in votes
    /\ votes' = votes \ {[bank |-> b, epoch |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed, authorized, clog>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, authorized, clog>>

Commit ==
    /\ Len(clog) < MaxSteps
    /\ Cardinality(ValidVoters) >= Quorum
    /\ clog' = Append(clog, [voters |-> ValidVoters])
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed, authorized>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Join(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Vote(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Withdraw(b)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Commit

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoUnauthOrStale ==
    \A k \in 1..Len(clog) :
        /\ Cardinality(clog[k].voters) >= Quorum
        /\ clog[k].voters \subseteq authorized
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
    Quorum = 2
    MaxSteps = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoUnauthOrStale

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m1p5t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N, Students

Registrars == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(r) == (r + 1) % N

VARIABLES token, elog, reqs, slow
vars == <<token, elog, reqs, slow>>

Enrolled == { elog[k].student : k \in DOMAIN elog }

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Registrars
    /\ elog \in Seq([student : Students, reg : Registrars])
    /\ reqs \subseteq Students
    /\ slow \subseteq Registrars

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ elog = <<>>
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Request(s) ==
    /\ s \notin reqs
    /\ s \notin Enrolled
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, elog, slow>>

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<elog, reqs, slow>>

GoSlow(r) == /\ r \notin slow /\ slow' = slow \cup {r} /\ UNCHANGED <<token, elog, reqs>>
Resume(r) == /\ r \in slow /\ slow' = slow \ {r} /\ UNCHANGED <<token, elog, reqs>>

Enroll(s) ==
    /\ s \in reqs
    /\ s \notin Enrolled
    /\ token \notin slow
    /\ elog' = Append(elog, [student |-> s, reg |-> token])
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : Request(s)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E r \in Registrars : GoSlow(r)
    \/ \E r \in Registrars : Resume(r)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Enroll(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EnrollOnce ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN elog : (elog[i].student = elog[j].student) => (i = j)
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Students = {s1, s2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EnrollOnce

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m6p4t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Zones, TTL, MaxCap, NoCar

VARIABLES load, owner, ttl, cap
vars == <<load, owner, ttl, cap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in [Cars -> 0..MaxCap]
    /\ owner \in [Zones -> Cars \cup {NoCar}]
    /\ ttl \in [Zones -> 0..TTL]
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ load = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ owner = [z \in Zones |-> NoCar]
    /\ ttl = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
    /\ cap = MaxCap

Acquire(c, z) ==
    /\ owner[z] = NoCar
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![z] = c]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![z] = TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap>>

Renew(c, z) ==
    /\ owner[z] = c
    /\ ttl[z] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![z] = TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, owner, cap>>

Tick ==
    /\ \E z \in Zones : ttl[z] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [z \in Zones |-> IF ttl[z] > 0 THEN ttl[z] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ owner' = [z \in Zones |-> IF ttl[z] = 1 THEN NoCar ELSE owner[z]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap>>

Board(c, z) ==
    /\ owner[z] = c
    /\ ttl[z] > 0
    /\ load[c] < cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = load[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ttl, cap>>

Alight(c) ==
    /\ load[c] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = load[c] - 1]

    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] # NoStudent
    /\ holders' = [holders EXCEPT ![alloc[s]] = holders[alloc[s]] \ {s}]
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NoStudent]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E r \in Registrars : GoSlow(r)
    \/ \E r \in Registrars : Resume(r)
    \/ \E s \in Seats, st \in Students : Allocate(s, st)
    \/ \E s \in Seats : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Consistent ==
    \A st \in Students, s \in Seats :
        (s \in holders[st]) <=> (alloc[s] = st)
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    Seats = {s1, s2}
    Students = {st1, st2}
    NoStudent = NoStudent
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Consistent

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m0p0t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, MaxVer, MaxCap, NoJob

Status == {"idle", "spooled", "printing"}

VARIABLES state, owner, ver, readVer, cap
vars == <<state, owner, ver, readVer, cap>>

Active == { j \in Jobs : state[j] # "idle" }

TypeOK ==
    /\ state \in [Jobs -> Status]
    /\ owner \in Jobs \cup {NoJob}
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ readVer \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ state = [j \in Jobs |-> "idle"]
    /\ owner = NoJob
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ readVer = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ cap = MaxCap

Admit(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "idle"
    /\ Cardinality(Active) < cap
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "spooled"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, readVer, cap>>

Read(j) ==
    /\ readVer[j] # ver
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![j] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, owner, ver, cap>>

Acquire(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "spooled"
    /\ owner = NoJob
    /\ readVer[j] = ver
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "printing"]
    /\ owner' = j
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<readVer, cap>>

Release(j) ==
    /\ state[j] = "printing"
    /\ owner = j
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ owner' = NoJob
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, readVer, cap>>

Reset ==
    /\ owner = NoJob
    /\ ver > 0
    /\ ver' = 0
    /\ readVer' = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, owner, cap>>

SetCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ c # cap
    /\ c >= Cardinality(Active)
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<state, owner, ver, readVer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Admit(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Read(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Acquire(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Release(j)
    \/ Reset
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutexSpool ==
    /\ \A j \in Jobs : (state[j] = "printing") <=> (owner = j)
    /\ Cardinality(Active) <= cap
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    MaxVer = 2
    MaxCap = 2
    NoJob = NoJob
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexSpool

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m9p5t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Rx, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, msgs, formulary, dlog
vars == <<epoch, msgs, formulary, dlog>>

Dispensed == { dlog[k].rx : k \in DOMAIN dlog }

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ msgs \subseteq [rx : Rx, ep : 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ formulary \subseteq Rx
    /\ dlog \in Seq([rx : Rx, ep : 0..MaxEpoch])

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ formulary = Rx
    /\ dlog = <<>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<msgs, formulary, dlog>>

SetFormulary(f) ==
    /\ f \subseteq Rx
    /\ f # formulary
    /\ formulary' = f
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, msgs, dlog>>

Order(rx) ==
    /\ [rx |-> rx, ep |-> epoch] \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[rx |-> rx, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, formulary, dlog>>

Dispense(rx) ==
    /\ \E m \in msgs : m.rx = rx /\ m.ep = epoch
    /\ rx \in formulary
    /\ rx \notin Dispensed
    /\ dlog' = Append(dlog, [rx |-> rx, ep |-> epoch])
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {[rx |-> rx, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, formulary>>

Recall(rx) ==
    /\ rx \in Dispensed
    /\ dlog' = SelectSeq(dlog, LAMBDA e : e.rx # rx)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, msgs, formulary>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E f \in SUBSET Rx : SetFormulary(f)
    \/ \E rx \in Rx : Order(rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Rx : Dispense(rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Rx : Recall(rx)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DispenseOnce ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN dlog : (dlog[i].rx = dlog[j].rx) => (i = j)
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Rx = {x1, x2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DispenseOnce

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m7p2t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Pharmacists, Total

VARIABLES stock, dispensed, quarantine, readv, adminOn
vars == <<stock, dispensed, quarantine, readv, adminOn>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0..Total
    /\ dispensed \in 0..Total
    /\ quarantine \in 0..Total
    /\ readv \in [Pharmacists -> 0..Total]
    /\ adminOn \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ stock = Total
    /\ dispensed = 0
    /\ quarantine = 0
    /\ readv = [p \in Pharmacists |-> Total]
    /\ adminOn = FALSE

Read(p) ==
    /\ readv[p] # stock
    /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![p] = stock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed, quarantine, adminOn>>

Dispense(p) ==
    /\ readv[p] = stock
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<quarantine, readv, adminOn>>

Restore(p) ==
    /\ readv[p] = stock
    /\ dispensed > 0
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<quarantine, readv, adminOn>>

AdminToggle ==
    /\ adminOn' = ~adminOn
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, dispensed, quarantine, readv>>

AdminQuarantine ==
    /\ adminOn
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ quarantine' = quarantine + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensed, readv, adminOn>>

AdminReturn ==
    /\ adminOn
    /\ quarantine > 0
    /\ quarantine' = quarantine - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensed, readv, adminOn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Dispense(p)
    \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Restore(p)
    \/ AdminToggle
    \/ AdminQuarantine
    \/ AdminReturn

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == stock + dispensed + quarantine = Total
============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {p1, p2}
    Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m6p4t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, Zone, Cap, TTL, NoTrain

VARIABLES lease, ttl, reqs, slow
vars == <<lease, ttl, reqs, slow>>

LiveZone == { b \in Zone : lease[b] # NoTrain }

TypeOK ==
    /\ lease \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {NoTrain}]
    /\ ttl \in [Blocks -> 0..TTL]
    /\ reqs \subseteq [train : Trains, block : Blocks]
    /\ slow \subseteq Trains

Init ==
    /\ lease = [b \in Blocks |-> NoTrain]
    /\ ttl = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ reqs = {}
    /\ slow = {}

Request(t, b) ==
    /\ [train |-> t, block |-> b] \notin reqs
    /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {[train |-> t, block |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, slow>>

AcquireLease(t, b) ==
    /\ t \notin slow
    /\ [train |-> t, block |-> b] \in reqs
    /\ lease[b] = NoTrain
    /\ (b \in Zone => Cardinality(LiveZone) < Cap)
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = TTL]
    /\ reqs' = reqs \ {[train |-> t, block |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

Renew(t, b) ==
    /\ t \notin slow
    /\ lease[b] = t
    /\ ttl[b] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, reqs, slow>>

Tick ==
    /\ \E b \in Blocks : ttl[b] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF ttl[b] > 0 THEN ttl[b] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ lease' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF ttl[b] = 1 THEN NoTrain ELSE lease[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, slow>>

Release(t, b) ==
    /\ lease[b] = t
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![b] = NoTrain]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqs, slow>>

GoSlow(t) == /\ t \notin slow /\ slow' = slow \cup {t} /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, reqs>>
Resume(t) == /\ t \in slow /\ slow' = slow \ {t} /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, reqs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Request(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : AcquireLease(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Renew(t, b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Release(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : GoSlow(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Resume(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LeaseCapacity == Cardinality(LiveZone) <= Cap
============================================================================
